newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror to redeem conversion preferred.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror to redeem conversion preferred.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said Friday it will redeem all of its issued and outstanding Conversion Preferred Stock, Series B, $1.00 par value, on April 2.

As required by the terms of the Series B Preferred Stock, the company will exchange each preferred share for 0.57083 Series A Common Share. Series B Preferred shareholders will also receive a check in payment for fractional shares and accrued and unpaid dividends, the company said.
About 4,446,000 common shares of Series A Common Stock will be issued in the redemption of about 7,789,000 Series B Preferred shares.

On Thursday, it noted, the closing price of the Series B Preferred Stock was $27.625 per share, and the closing price of the Series A Common Stock was $52 per share. Series B Preferred Stock has paid an annual dividend of $1.374 per share. Initially, 16,561,178 Series B Preferred shares were issued in an exchange offer completed in March 1995.
Times Mirror said the redemption is part of its previously announced ongoing stock repurchase program.
Since March 1995, the company has repurchased 8,772,000 Series B Preferred shares. As of December 31, 1996, 7,789,000 Series B Preferred shares were outstanding.

In connection with the stock repurchase program, the company said, at the end of 1996 and continuing into 1997 it has entered into a series of forward purchase contracts with respect to about 3.9 million Series B Preferred shares.

These contracts, which mature in 1998 but may be terminated prior to maturity, are structured to be settled on a net basis in shares of Series B Preferred, or in shares of Series A Common if the Series B Preferred were redeemed prior to the maturity of the contracts, Times Mirror said.
Harris Trust Company of California will act as Redemption Agent for the redemption of the Series B Preferred.
